question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution:
The erroneous spelling is **Charishma**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling and meaning of the selected option are as follows:
 
 
• **Charisma:** a powerful personal quality that some people have to attract and influence other people.
 
 

Thus, the incorrectly spelt word is **Charishma**. 

 
• Thus,the correct answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cavalier:** showing a lack of proper concern; offhand.
 
• **Elegant:** having a good or attractive style.
 
• **Dominate:** to be more powerful, important.
